title: PATCHING LLM LIKE SOFTWARE: A LIGHTWEIGHT METHOD FOR IMPROVING SAFETY POLICY IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to 1,000 professional-context prompts designed to elicit gendered associations. The paper measures explicit bias using the Gender Attribute Score (GAS), which tracks the percentage of generated sentences containing gender-specific words, and implicit bias using the Gender Logits Difference (GLD), which calculates the normalized difference between logits assigned to female versus male pronouns.
